If y rejects me, I end up at w, which I really don't want.

Given that y is so popular, and I'm not a top priority for x, I should stick to my true preferences. Trying to game the system by hoping for y to be available seems risky. I'm better off prioritizing x and z, as I have a reasonable chance of getting accepted to one of them.

Therefore, my ranking will remain as stated: x > z > y > w. This maximizes my chances of getting one of my preferred schools.
